Along with the [[harvap]], with which it had no relation,<ref name="Codex" /> the '''harvorisk''' was one of the few animals that was capable of surviving [[Quesh]]'s toxic atmosphere. After their discovery on [[Nim Drovis]] by [[Jarn Harvus]], the harvorisks were hunted by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], who considered it alternately an exotic new pet and a tasty meal. 

==History==
The [[Three Families]] introduced harvorisks to Quesh, genetically modifying them to survive in the atmosphere but at the cost of half of their lifespan. However, due to its rapid rate of breeding and vicious behavior, they decided to get free of them, releasing creatures into the wild. The Hutts refused to accept responsibility for the creatures’ escape, but the harvorisks begun reproducing, seeking prey among the planet’s miners.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Harvorisk}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]], harvorisks in the [[Glacial Trespass]] area of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] are named "Havoirisks".
